feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 26 November 2026 3:20pm
items.description:
##Today##

Dry for much of today, but cloudy, with a moderate to fresh southeast wind, becoming fresh to strong this afternoon. Top temperature 8°C. Rain then arrives this evening as the wind strengthens a little more, possibly touching gale force around the northern and southern tips of the island. Rain continues overnight, turning heavy at times, with a minimum temperature around 4°C. Comments: Strong winds. Risk of gales in exposed areas later. Coatal overtopping warning in place from 22:30 until 02:30 tomorrow, see warning for details. Heavy rain warning overnight into Frida, see warning for details

##Tomorrow##

Rain continues from Thursday night, turning heavy at times before clearing during Friday morning, leaving the rest of the day dry with sunny spells developing. Strong southeast winds will ease as the rain clears, becoming a light to moderate westerly, then southeast again later in the day. Top temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds. Coastal overtopping warning in place until 02:30, see warning for details. Heavy rain - risk of localised flooding.
